purpose: Clarify the mathematical and ecological meaning of the frozen spatial-depth/concentration endpoints without adding a new mechanism claim.
population: Exactly the frozen 4,236 NAAMP wetter-drier matched pairs used by the spatial-depth analysis.

focal_objects.k: Number of wet-survey occupied stops for a route-new taxon (absent from all dry stops).
focal_objects.marginal_jth_site: For j=1..10, count route-new taxa with k>=j. This is the contribution of the j-th occupied stop, one per taxon reaching that depth.
focal_objects.exact_k: For k=1..10, count route-new taxa occupying exactly k wet stops.

identities: H = P - extra_stop exactly, because choose(k,2)=choose(k-1,2)+(k-1)
Therefore H and standard within-taxon site-pair count P contain identical concentration information after conditioning on extra_stop.
inference: Use the same residualized rain design as the frozen spatial-depth analysis. Report observed coefficients for exact-k and marginal j-th-site components. Compare marginal j-th-site coefficients with the same 1,000 uniform-activation and a=0.75 persistence-preserving null simulations.
interpretation_rules: Do not call k=3 a biological threshold unless the marginal third-site component itself shows a discontinuity relative to second and deeper components.
Do not call the depth pattern exponential unless a separately justified shape model is fit and supported; this audit does not authorize such a claim.

If cumulative third-plus is exceptional while individual marginal-depth coefficients are similar/small, interpret the result as a heavy/deep tail accumulating beyond the second site rather than a threshold at exactly three sites.
Simple total occupied-site counts measure amount of spread, not how that spread is allocated among taxa. Concentration H is only interpreted conditional on recruitment and extra-stop spread.
